result.stdout:
github-repo-structure-mcp

Runs a stdio MCP server that fetches GitHub repository directory structures via the git/trees API.

Usage:
  github-repo-structure-mcp
  github-repo-structure-mcp help
  github-repo-structure-mcp mcp-install --provider codex|claude|copilot|gemini|opencode|all [--name github-repo-structure] [--token <PAT>]
  github-repo-structure-mcp mcp-install --config <mcp.json> [--name github-repo-structure] [--token <PAT>]
  github-repo-structure-mcp mcp-remove --provider codex|claude|copilot|gemini|opencode|all [--name github-repo-structure]
  github-repo-structure-mcp mcp-remove --config <mcp.json> [--name github-repo-structure]
  github-repo-structure-mcp mcp-uninstall --provider codex|claude|copilot|gemini|opencode|all [--name github-repo-structure]
  github-repo-structure-mcp mcp-uninstall --config <mcp.json> [--name github-repo-structure]

Providers:
  codex     Uses: codex mcp add/remove
  claude    Uses: claude mcp add/remove
  copilot   Uses: copilot mcp add/remove
  gemini    Uses: gemini mcp add/remove
  opencode  Edits ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json directly
  all       Runs every supported provider and prints a result summary

Options:
  --provider <name>  Install or remove through a supported provider CLI.
  --config <path>    Edit an arbitrary mcp.json directly for other providers.
  --name <name>      MCP server name. Defaults to github-repo-structure.
  --token <PAT>      GitHub Personal Access Token. If omitted, prompts interactively or reads GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var.

Examples:
  github-repo-structure-mcp mcp-install --provider codex
  github-repo-structure-mcp mcp-install --provider all --token ghp_xxxxxxxxxxxx
  github-repo-structure-mcp mcp-install --config C:\path\to\mcp.json --name github-repo-structure
  github-repo-structure-mcp mcp-remove --provider claude

  --config <config>      Path to an mcp.json file to edit directly.
  --name <name>          MCP server name. [default: github-repo-structure]
  --token <token>        GitHub Personal Access Token. If omitted, prompts interactively or reads GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var.
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
